synopsis: Python is a recurring interface across the simulation tools: Prescan supports Python and MATLAB APIs alongside OpenSCENARIO, while CARLA exposes a Python API alongside other interfaces [f8458, f9005, f9011, f16237]. Sensor tooling also uses Python: CARLA lists cameras, lidar, radar, GNSS and IMU, while BeamNG.tech lists programmable cameras, lidar, radar, ultrasonic and IMU sensors with a Python API [f8468, f9085, f8504]. Beyond these platforms, Project Chrono lists Python, C# and Unity interfaces, and the glossary identifies Scenic, CropCraft and Demify as Python-driven generators [f9025, f9125, f16238]. The job-site chapter identifies CropCraft as an open-source Blender and Python tool dated November 2025 for generating agricultural fields; the tool listings further connect Scenic to multiple simulators and list Python and CPU/GPU for Demify [f3787, f9211, f9143].
